title: Seller-Tester brief catalog (D9)
note: Amazon-ready product-picture situations across eight categories. source_mode names the single input a brief starts from: the prompt alone (prompt_only), a stored reference from an earlier generation (stored_reference), or a file the seller uploads (uploaded_reference). Reference modes carry a reference object; a prompt_only brief must not. Stored references point at real assets under renders/, and the Mogra Organic pouch is the only product with stored generations in this checkout. Uploaded references name the seller's own file and have no local copy here, so their reference check reports cannot-verify, which counts as a failure until the upload exists. Constraints are checked programmatically; the vision judge is optional.

fill_pct.note: area share of the frame. Amazon main-image guidance asks for at least 85% linear fill and sets no upper bound; at 85% linear a square subject is ~72% area, so the former 55-70% area caps would reject a compliant main image. No cap is applied.

aplus_note: A+ content modules are a distinct seller deliverable from product pictures: an ordered page of modules with their own pixel grid and required copy. Each A+ brief declares its modules (id, kind, width, height, order), the copy each module must show, and the product-in-frame rule. product_in_frame: true means the seller's own product pixels must be composited, which is only lawful with fidelity exact and a reference; the single product_in_frame: false text-only brand story is the one place fidelity tolerant is used.

aplus_briefs.note: Text-only brand story: no product pixels, so 'tolerant' is lawful here and only here.
